<style>
:root{--bg:#f6f7f9;--card:#fff;--tx:#14181f;--mu:#5d6675;--br:#e2e5ea;--pr:#0a8f4e;--pr2:#067a42;--ac:#ff9d00;--wa:#25d366;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0f1318;--card:#181e26;--tx:#eef1f5;--mu:#9aa4b2;--br:#2a323d}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0f1318;--card:#181e26;--tx:#eef1f5;--mu:#9aa4b2;--br:#2a323d}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font:15px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:1150px;margin:auto;padding:0 16px}
header{background:var(--pr);color:#fff;position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.logo{font-weight:800;font-size:20px;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.3px}.logo svg{width:40px;height:40px;flex:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px #0003)}.logo span{color:#ffd27a}.logo img{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;flex:none;object-fit:cover}.hero .wrap{display:flex;gap:24px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.hl{height:150px;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;padding:8px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #0004}@media(max-width:520px){.hl{height:110px}}.logo small{display:block;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.8;margin-top:2px}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.b-w{background:var(--wa);color:#073b1b}.b-c{background:#fff;color:var(--pr2)}.b-s{background:var(--ac);color:#2b1a00}.b-p{background:var(--pr);color:#fff}.b-o{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--br)}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pr),#04552d);color:#fff;padding:28px 0 32px}
.hero h1{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:clamp(24px,5vw,38px)}.hero p{margin:0 0 16px;opacity:.9}
.search{display:flex;gap:8px;max-width:640px}.search input{flex:1;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:10px;border:0;color:#14181f;background:#fff}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:14px 0}.chip{white-space:nowrap;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--br);background:var(--card);cursor:pointer}
.chip.on{background:var(--pr);color:#fff;border-color:var(--pr)}
.bar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}.bar select{padding:8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--br);background:var(--card)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:14px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--br);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.ph{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d8f3e4,#bfe3f5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:56px;position:relative}
.ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.tag{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;background:#000a;color:#fff;font-size:11px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px}
.cb{padding:10px 12px}.cb h3{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.3}.pr{color:var(--pr);font-weight:800;font-size:17px;margin:4px 0}.mu{color:var(--mu);font-size:13px}
.how{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:16px}.how div{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--br);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px}.how b{display:block;color:var(--pr)}.lock{background:var(--bg);border:2px dashed var(--pr);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-top:12px}.lock ol{padding-left:18px;margin:8px 0}.lock li{margin-bottom:8px}.acct{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--br);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-top:4px}.lock a{color:var(--pr);font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline}.ok{background:#e3f8ea;color:#065c2c;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600;margin-top:12px}.note{background:#fff7e0;color:#5a4300;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:10px}
.empty{padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--mu)}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000b;z-index:50;display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;overflow:auto;padding:16px}
.modal.open{display:flex}.box{background:var(--card);border-radius:14px;max-width:640px;width:100%;padding:18px;margin:auto}
.box h2{margin:0 0 10px}.x{float:right;background:none;border:0;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}
.f{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.f .full{grid-column:1/-1}
label{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:3px}
.f input,.f select,.f textarea{width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--br);background:var(--bg)}
.imgs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}.imgs img{width:70px;height:70px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px}
.gal{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;margin-bottom:10px}.gal img,.gal .ph{height:220px;min-width:100%;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover}
.sp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin:10px 0}.sp div{background:var(--bg);padding:8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px}.sp b{display:block;color:var(--mu);font-weight:500}
.acts{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
.safe{background:#fff7e0;color:#5a4300;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;font-size:13px;margin-top:12px}
footer{margin-top:30px;background:#0c1a12;color:#cfe;padding:24px 0;font-size:14px}footer .wrap{display:flex;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between}
.fab{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:var(--wa);color:#073b1b;border-radius:99px;padding:12px 16px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0004;z-index:15}
@media(max-width:520px){.f{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hide{display:none}}

<form id="sf" onsubmit="return save(event)"><div class="f">

<script>

const SEED=[
{id:"s1",title:"iPhone 13 Pro Max 256GB",cat:"Phones",brand:"Apple",model:"iPhone 13 Pro Max",cond:"Foreign Used",storage:"256GB",ram:"6GB",color:"Sierra Blue",war:"1 month",price:780000,neg:"Yes",state:"Lagos",area:"Ikeja",desc:"Clean UK used, battery health 91%, Face ID working, no scratches. Official warranty.",seller:"Lekzy Gadgets",phone:"09112421834",wa:"09063165018",imgs:[],t:2},
{id:"s5",title:"AirPods Pro 2nd Gen",cat:"Audio",brand:"Apple",model:"AirPods Pro 2",cond:"Brand New",storage:"",ram:"",color:"White",war:"6 months",price:165000,neg:"Yes",state:"Oyo",area:"Ibadan",desc:"Sealed, MagSafe case with USB-C.",seller:"Lekzy Gadgets",phone:"09112421834",wa:"09063165018",imgs:[],t:1}];
let mine=[],cat="All",imgs=[],unl=[];
const CFG={fee:500,days:7,bank:"PalmPay",name:"Rasheed Olamilekan Abdulgafar",acct:"9112421834",pin:"2468"};
try{unl=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("lg_unl")||"[]")}catch(e){}
try{mine=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("lg_ads")||"[]")}catch(e){}
const all=()=>[...mine,...SEED];
const N=n=>"₦"+Number(n).toLocaleString("en-NG");
const ic=c=>(CATS.find(x=>x[1]==c)||["📦"])[0];
const esc=s=>String(s||"").replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
const num=p=>String(p).replace(/\D/g,"").replace(/^0/,"234");
document.getElementById("chips").innerHTML=["All",...CATS.map(c=>c[1])].map(c=>`<button class="chip ${c=="All"?"on":""}" onclick="setCat('${c}',this)">${c=="All"?"🛒 All":ic(c)+" "+c}</button>`).join("");
document.getElementById("catSel").innerHTML=CATS.map(c=>`<option>${c[1]}</option>`).join("");
const so=STATES.map(s=>`<option>${s}</option>`).join("");
document.getElementById("stSel").innerHTML=so;document.getElementById("st").innerHTML+=so;
function setCat(c,el){cat=c;document.querySelectorAll(".chip").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("on"));el.classList.add("on");render()}
function render(){purge();
 const q=document.getElementById("q").value.toLowerCase(),co=cond.value,s=st.value,o=so_.value;
 let l=all().filter(a=>(cat=="All"||a.cat==cat)&&(!co||a.cond==co)&&(!s||a.state==s)&&(!q||(a.title+a.brand+a.model+a.desc).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
 l.sort((a,b)=>o=="l"?a.price-b.price:o=="h"?b.price-a.price:b.t-a.t);
 cnt.textContent=l.length+" ads";
 grid.innerHTML=l.length?l.map(a=>`<div class="card" onclick="view('${a.id}')"><div class="ph">${a.imgs[0]?`<img src="${a.imgs[0]}" alt="">`:ic(a.cat)}<span class="tag">${a.status=="pending"?"⏳ Pending payment":esc(a.cond)}</span></div><div class="cb"><h3>${esc(a.title)}</h3><div class="pr">${N(a.price)}</div><div class="mu">📍 ${esc(a.area)}, ${esc(a.state)}</div></div></div>`).join(""):'<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">No gadgets found. const so_=document.getElementById("so");

 const w=num(a.wa||a.phone),sp=[["Brand",a.brand],["Model",a.model],["Condition",a.cond],["Storage",a.storage],["RAM",a.ram],["Color",a.color],["Warranty",a.war],["Negotiable",a.neg]].filter(x=>x[1]);
 mb.innerHTML=`<button class="x" onclick="closeM('mv')">×</button><div class="gal">${a.imgs.length?a.imgs.map(i=>`<img src="${i}" alt="">`).join(""):`<div class="ph">${ic(a.cat)}</div>`}</div>
 <h2>${esc(a.title)}</h2><div class="pr" style="font-size:24px">${N(a.price)}</div><div class="mu">📍 ${esc(a.area)}, ${esc(a.state)} · ${esc(a.cat)}</div>
 <div class="sp">${sp.map(x=>`<div><b>${x[0]}</b>${esc(x[1])}</div>`).join("")}</div>
 <p style="white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(a.desc)}</p><div class="mu">Seller: <b>${esc(a.seller)}</b></div>
 ${contact(a,w)}<div class="acts">${own?`<button class="btn b-o" onclick="del('${a.id}')">🗑 Delete ad</button>`:""}</div>
 <div class="safe">⚠️ Safety tip: meet in a public place, test the gadget, check IMEI/serial, and never pay in advance.</div>`;mv.classList.add("open")}
function code(id){let h=5381;for(const c of id+CFG.pin)h=((h*33)^c.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;return String(h%900000+100000)}
const DAY=864e5,persist=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem("lg_ads",JSON.stringify(mine))}catch(e){}};
const today=()=>new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA");
let pass=0,bref="BUY-"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7).toUpperCase();
try{pass=+localStorage.getItem("lg_pass")||0;bref=localStorage.getItem("lg_bid")||bref;localStorage.setItem("lg_bid",bref)}catch(e){}
const passOk=()=>pass>Date.now();
function left(){const m=Math.ceil((pass-Date.now())/6e4);return Math.floor(m/60)+"h "+m%60+"m"}
function gen(){const v=document.getElementById("aid").value.trim();document.getElementById("ao").textContent=v?code(v.toUpperCase().startsWith("BUY-")?v.toUpperCase()+today():v):""}
function unlockPass(id){if(document.getElementById("uc").value.trim()!==code(bref+today())){alert("Wrong code. Please check the access code Lekzy sent you.");return}pass=Date.now()+DAY;try{localStorage.setItem("lg_pass",pass)}catch(e){}view(id)}
function buyBox(a){const fee=N(CFG.fee),pm=encodeURIComponent("Hello Lekzy, I have paid the "+fee+" inspection fee. Buyer Ref: "+bref+". Receipt attached. Please send my 24-hour access code.");
 return `<div class="lock"><b>🔒 Seller's phone &amp; WhatsApp are hidden</b><p class="mu" style="margin:6px 0">Pay the inspection fee once and view <b>every</b> seller's contact for <b>24 hours</b>.</p><ol><li>Pay <b>${fee}</b> to:<div class="acct">${esc(CFG.bank)}<br><b>${esc(CFG.acct)}</b><br>${esc(CFG.name)}</div><div class="note" style="margin:6px 0 0">⚠️ <b>Warning:</b> do not add any description/remark to the transfer.</div></li><li><a href="https://wa.me/2349063165018?text=${pm}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Send your payment receipt to Lekzy on WhatsApp</a> (Your Ref: <b>${bref}</b>)</li><li>Enter the access code Lekzy sends you:</li></ol><div class="f"><input id="uc" placeholder="Access code" inputmode="numeric"><button class="btn b-p" onclick="unlockPass('${a.id}')">Unlock for 24 hours</button></div></div>`}
function purge(){const n=mine.length,t=Date.now();mine=mine.filter(a=>(a.status=="pending"?a.t+CFG.days*DAY:a.exp)>t);if(mine.length!=n)persist()}
function activate(id){if(document.getElementById("uc").value.trim()!==code(id)){alert("Wrong code. Please check the activation code Lekzy sent you.");return}const a=mine.find(x=>x.id==id);if(!a)return;a.status="live";a.exp=Date.now()+CFG.days*DAY;persist();render();view(id)}

  const d=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((a.exp-Date.now())/DAY));h=`<div class="ok">✅ Your ad is live · deletes automatically in ${d} day${d>1?"s":""}</div>`}
 if(!h){if(!passOk())return buyBox(a);h='<div class="ok">✅ Inspection pass active · '+left()+' left</div>'}
 return h+`<div class="acts"><a class="btn b-p" href="tel:${esc(a.phone)}">📞 Call ${esc(a.phone)}</a><a class="btn b-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://wa.me/${w}?text=${encodeURIComponent("Hello, is '"+a.title+"' ("+N(a.price)+") still available? function oldContact(a,w){const fee=N(CFG.fee);
 if(mine.some(x=>x.id==a.id))return '<div class="safe">This is your ad (ID '+a.id+'). Buyers pay a '+fee+' inspection fee to Lekzy before they can see your number.</div>';
 if(unl.includes(a.id))return `<div class="ok">✅ Inspection fee confirmed</div><div class="acts"><a class="btn b-p" href="tel:${esc(a.phone)}">📞 Call ${esc(a.phone)}</a><a class="btn b-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://wa.me/${w}?text=${encodeURIComponent("Hello, I'm interested in '"+a.title+"' ("+N(a.price)+"). Lekzy Gadgets referred me.")}">WhatsApp seller</a></div>`;
 const pm=encodeURIComponent("Hello Lekzy, I have paid the "+fee+" inspection fee for Ad ID "+a.id+" ("+a.title+"). Receipt attached. Please send my unlock code.");
 return `<div class="lock"><b>🔒 Seller's phone &amp; WhatsApp are hidden</b><ol><li>Pay the <b>${fee}</b> inspection fee to:<div class="acct">${esc(CFG.bank)}<br><b>${esc(CFG.acct)}</b><br>${esc(CFG.name)}</div><div class="note" style="margin:6px 0 0">⚠️ <b>Warning:</b> do not add any description/remark to the transfer.</div></li><li><a href="https://wa.me/2348164866620?text=${pm}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Send your payment receipt to Lekzy on WhatsApp</a> (Ad ID: <b>${a.id}</b>)</li><li>Enter the unlock code Lekzy sends you:</li></ol><div class="f"><input id="uc" placeholder="Unlock code" inputmode="numeric"><button class="btn b-p" onclick="unlock('${a.id}')">Unlock contact</button></div></div>`}
function unlock(id){if(document.getElementById("uc").value.trim()!==code(id)){alert("Wrong code. Please check the code Lekzy sent you.");return}unl.push(id);try{localStorage.setItem("lg_unl",JSON.stringify(unl))}catch(e){}view(id)}
function admin(){if(prompt("Admin PIN")!==CFG.pin)return;mb.innerHTML=`<button class="x" onclick="closeM('mv')">×</button><h2>Lekzy Admin: activation codes</h2><p class="mu">After confirming a payment, enter the seller's Ad ID (posting fee) or the buyer's Ref like BUY-XXXXX (24-hour pass), then send them the code.</p><div class="f"><input id="aid" placeholder="Ad ID or Buyer Ref"><button class="btn b-p" onclick="gen()">Get code</button></div><h1 id="ao"></h1>`;mv.classList.add("open")}
function closeM(i){document.getElementById(i).classList.remove("open")}
function openSell(){ms.classList.add("open")}
function pics(inp){imgs=[];pv.innerHTML="";[...inp.files].slice(0,5).forEach(f=>{const r=new FileReader;r.onload=e=>{const im=new Image;im.onload=()=>{const k=Math.min(1,800/Math.max(im.width,im.height)),c=document.createElement("canvas");c.width=im.width*k;c.height=im.height*k;c.getContext("2d").drawImage(im,0,0,c.width,c.height);const d=c.toDataURL("image/jpeg",.7);imgs.push(d);pv.innerHTML+=`<img src="${d}" alt="">`};im.src=e.target.result};r.readAsDataURL(f)})}
function save(e){e.preventDefault();if(!imgs.length){alert("Please add at least one photo.");return false}
 const d=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.target));delete d.ph;d.price=+d.price;d.imgs=imgs;d.status="pending";d.id="L"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7).toUpperCase();d.t=Date.now();mine.unshift(d);
 try{localStorage.setItem("lg_ads",JSON.stringify(mine))}catch(x){alert("Ad posted, but storage is full so it may not be saved after you leave.")}
 e.target.reset();imgs=[];pv.innerHTML="";closeM("ms");cat="All";document.querySelectorAll(".chip").forEach((x,i)=>x.classList.toggle("on",!i));render();view(d.id);return false}
function del(id){if(!confirm("Delete this ad?"))return;mine=mine.filter(x=>x.id!=id);try{localStorage.setItem("lg_ads",JSON.stringify(mine))}catch(e){}closeM("mv");render()}
render();
</script></body></html>
